gAwbcxJw-c8i.code:
const effect1 = register('effect1', (pat) => pat
                         .s("sawtooth")
                         .cutoff(300)
                         .room(0.8)
                         
)

const effect2 = register('effect2', (pat) => pat
                        .s("square")
                        .cutoff(400)
                        .room(0.8)
                        .delay(0.5)
                        .attack(0.5)
                        .decay(0.5)
                        .gain(0.3)
)

const effect3 = register('effect3', (pat) => pat
                        .s("triangle")
                        .cutoff(700)
                        .room(1.0)
                        .delay(0.8)
                        .gain(0.3)
                        
)


$: note("c3 f3 e3 g3").effect1().delay(0.5)

$: note("<c4 d4 e4 f4 g4 f4>*8").effect1().delay(0.5)

//$: note("")

$: note("<g5 a5 b5 g5 e5 d5>*2").effect2()

$: note("<c6 - d6 b5 - f5 a5>*1").effect3()
